### Finding Joy in the Dark: The Bold Prayer of Psalm 70
Author: Stephen Witmer
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/finding-joy-in-the-dark
Passage: Psalm 70:4
Points:
- Even faithful believers and shepherds experience intense personal pain, weakness, and dark trials.
- Psalm 70 is framed by urgent, desperate appeals for God to deliver the psalmist without delay.
- Amid fierce opposition, David prays an expansive prayer not only for himself but for all God-seekers to rejoice.
- Pursuing God-centered joy and declaring His greatness does not have to wait until hardships are fully resolved.
- Believers can seek God and treasure His salvation immediately, fixing their eyes on Him even in life's storms.
